title_as_printed: Experimental "uncorrected Henry's law constants" h_2,1 at the indicated temperatures T and total pressures p, Henry's law constants H_2,1(T, p_s,1), and individual percentage deviations delta_i from smoothed values calculated via equations (9) and (12), and Ostwald coefficients L_2,1^inf at infinite dilution. For the exact significance of h_2,1 see references 5, and 10 to 12
pressure_note: total equilibrium pressure p (water vapour plus oxygen), column 10^-3 p/Pa

value.what: Henry's law constant H_2,1(T,p_s,1) = lim f_2L/x_2 of O2 in water at the vapour pressure of water (mole-fraction basis, Pa); calculated by the authors point by point from the measured h_2,1 via H = h Z^V phi^V I^-1 (Poynting correction, virial coefficients)

value2.what: Ostwald coefficient at infinite dilution (c_2^L/c_2^V at equilibrium, limit), calculated by the authors from H_2,1 via eq. (14),(15)

extra_unmapped: 10^-9 h_2,1 /Pa (uncorrected Henry's law constant, primary experimental quantity; no p-independent definition of a standard state)
delta_i (percentage deviation from the authors' smoothed fit, eq. 12)
conversion_needs: Ostwald coefficient is volumetric concentration ratio, kept as printed
notes: Gas-free reference pure water, oxygen solute; solubility at about 100 kPa total pressure. Rows 0-13 are region I (274.15-281.14 K), rows 14-31 region II (283.17-328.14 K) in the authors' fitting. Replicate temperatures (e.g. 298.152 K, 318.16 K) are separate runs.
